invariants.rationale: If b is 0, we don't perform the division; otherwise, the result is a divided by b.
If b is 0, the method returns Integer.MIN_VALUE as a designated 'error' value.
If b is not 0, result equals a / b; thus, result * b is a - remainder.
When b is 0, the result is Integer.MIN_VALUE, which is a negative number.
The absolute value of the quotient (when b != 0) or the special value is always less than or equal to |a|.
